scripts.purpose: Shared safety, configuration, privilege, path, health-check, client-publish, and credential helpers for supported operations.
scripts.invocation: Internal library; source only from scripts/ops/*.sh.
scripts.safety: Strict shell mode, path containment, hidden secret values, temporary MongoDB config files with mode 0600, and client files published by rename with earlier hashed assets kept.

scripts.purpose: Read-only production checkout, environment, service, and readiness validation.
scripts.safety: Does not modify Git, dependencies, service state, or data and never prints secret values.

scripts.purpose: Deploy a verified production branch to the systemd-managed DeFTrack service, or roll it back to an earlier commit.
scripts.invocation: npm run ops:deploy -- --dry-run; npm run ops:deploy; npm run ops:deploy -- --expect-commit <full hash>; npm run ops:deploy -- --rollback-to <commit>
scripts.safety: Runs one deploy or rollback at a time, requires a clean checkout on the expected branch, can require an exact remote commit, uses fast-forward-only Git updates, runs checks and build before restart, builds the client beside the live one so a failed build leaves it untouched, limits rollbacks to earlier commits, and verifies readiness.

scripts.purpose: Create compressed, complete-marker-protected MongoDB backups with bounded retention.
scripts.invocation: npm run ops:backup -- --dry-run; npm run ops:backup
scripts.safety: Uses a mode-0600 temporary MongoDB config, removes incomplete dumps, and restricts retention deletion to the backup root.

scripts.purpose: Restore a verified MongoDB dump after creating a safety backup.
scripts.invocation: npm run ops:restore -- --backup defcon_explorer_TIMESTAMP --dry-run; add --yes for a real restore.
scripts.safety: Requires an in-root completed backup and explicit --yes, creates a pre-restore backup, controls systemd state, and verifies readiness.

scripts.purpose: Measure API latency, throughput, and error rate against an explicitly selected base URL.
scripts.safety: Read-only benchmark; run it only against infrastructure you operate and size concurrency for the target environment.

scripts.purpose: Measure WebSocket connection and event-delivery behavior.
scripts.safety: Read-only benchmark; run it only against infrastructure you operate and size connection count and spread for the target environment.
